gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla is a serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, with an opened e that reads crisp and authoritative. Delius Unicase draws one uniform, plotter-pen line.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear reads lofty and modern, a plain sans with open mouths on its letters and a tall x-height. Delius Unicase brings a relaxed, bent-paperclip handwritten warmth.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-pt-sans-caption: Delius Unicase looks like twine pressed flat, relaxed and inviting, with strokes that never taper or swell. PT Sans Caption follows with big-bodied lowercase and unclosed bowls that keep a full page easy going.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-puritan: Puritan reads rounded and approachable, its plain sans forms open to the side.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-questrial: Delius Unicase has strokes with no tapering at all.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-radio-canada: Relaxed handwriting leads in Delius Unicase, its strokes untapered and its spacing as regular as rope-ladder rungs. Radio Canada then runs on steadily in sans-serif lines.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-radio-canada-bi: Radio Canada Big reads as a sans with a monoline skeleton, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem. Delius Unicase adds handwritten ease above.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-readex-pro: Delius Unicase spaces its letters like rungs on a rope ladder.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-roboto: Relaxed and inviting, Delius Unicase keeps its strokes untapered, so no hairlines vanish if the heading shrinks. And Roboto, a clean sans with generous round mouths, stays comfortable even when the body grows large.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-ruda: Ruda reads like wire, a plain sans with a sizable x-height.
